annotations.title: Turn on a ready-made source for a track

description: Turns on one of TrackerHacker's ready-made sources for a track (from find_hacks with its trackId, under ready): a service that posts to the sheet's link (Shopify, Stripe, GitHub), one TrackerHacker asks on a schedule (a social account's posts), or a reminder that asks the person. Attaches its hacks with the mappings that fill the sheet and returns what the person does next in that service: connect (steps, and a link to paste), webhookUrl, fetch (a scheduled fetch to add with scheduled_fetches, once the person gives what it asks for) or reminder. Links and fetches are the person's connections, not a sheet's: when the service already posts to another of their sheets on another topic, or TrackerHacker already asks it on a schedule for one, this sheet is filled through that connection instead (alreadyConnected), with nothing new to set up; otherwise a webhook source gets a link of its own. The answer names the connection used and otherConnections, the person's others it could use: if they'd rather use one of those (connectionId), or a new one for another account or store (newConnection true), call this again with it. Call it once the person has said which source.

connectionId.description: Optional: one of the person's connections to arrive through, from otherConnections or also_fill list.

newConnection.description: Optional: a new connection for this sheet, not one the person already has.

readyId.description: From find_hacks with this trackId, under ready.
